name: Emergency fund planner
audience: Households building a first cash reserve for rent, food, transport, and medical aid.
summary: Turn one month of essential costs into a three-month target and a monthly contribution.
description: List the costs you would still pay if income stopped. The workbook multiplies that essential total by the number of months you choose, then estimates how many months the contribution will take.
benefits: Separate essential costs from costs you could pause
Set a month target without guessing a lump sum
See how long the current contribution takes
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
